_meta.indication: IOMERVU is a radiographic contrast agent indicated for intravenous procedures: CT of the head and body; CT angiography of intracranial, visceral, and lower extremity arteries; coronary CT angiography; and CT urography in adults and pediatric patients (NDA 216017 covers the intravenous indications); the shared label also covers intra-arterial procedures.

pivotal_trials.trial_name: IOM-104E (CT head and body) — blinded re-read of studies 48,848-007A, -007B, -008A, -008B
pivotal_trials.phase: Blinded re-read of prospective, randomized, double-blind, parallel group phase 3 imaging studies
pivotal_trials.design: Prospective, multi-center, double-blind, randomized active-comparator-controlled studies; patients randomized to Iomervu or iopamidol, with blinded independent re-read of images
pivotal_trials.population: Adult patients with a history or diagnosis necessitating head and/or body CT for diagnostic, preoperative, or postoperative evaluation
pivotal_trials.endpoint: % adequate visualization on a 2-point scale and non-inferiority to comparator (10% non-inferiority margin)
pivotal_trials.n: 59 patients received Iomervu 400 mg/mL (vs 55 iopamidol 370) and 59 received Iomervu 250 mg/mL (vs 57 iopamidol 250)
pivotal_trials.result: At least 98% (lower bound of 95% CI at least 91%) of image sets in Iomervu and comparator groups were rated adequate; the largest between-group difference was 1.7 (95% CI -1.6, 5.0), within the 10% non-inferiority margin

key_safety: Safety evaluated in 4,923 patients, of whom 4,804 received up to the recommended total iodine dose of 86 grams. Most common adverse reactions (incidence ≥0.5%) are feeling hot (1.8%), headache (1.1%), nausea (1.0%), chest pain (0.6%), back pain (0.5%), and vomiting (0.5%). Serious adverse reactions occurred in 28 patients (0.6%). Serious risks include life-threatening or fatal hypersensitivity reactions, acute kidney injury, and cardiovascular adverse reactions.
target_moa: Iomeprol is a radiographic iodinated contrast agent that opacifies the vessels and body structures where it is present following intravenous or intra-arterial administration, permitting radiographic visualization of internal structures through attenuation of X-ray photons.
modality: Small molecule — iodinated radiographic contrast agent (iomeprol), a new molecular entity

boxed_warning.content: WARNING: RISKS ASSOCIATED WITH INTRATHECAL ADMINISTRATION — intrathecal administration, even if inadvertent, may cause death, convulsions, cerebral hemorrhage, coma, paralysis, arachnoiditis, acute renal failure, cardiac arrest, seizures, rhabdomyolysis, hyperthermia, and brain edema. IOMERVU is for intra-arterial or intravenous use only.

advisory_committee.vote: No advisory committee meeting was held; outside expertise was not necessary and there were no controversial issues.

summary.text: IOMERVU (iomeprol) was approved as a 505(b)(2) New Drug Application (NDA 216017 for IV indications, NDA 216016 for IA indications) under Standard review for a new molecular entity, with no accelerated approval, breakthrough, fast track, orphan, or priority designation and no advisory committee meeting.
